calibration.baseline: constant probability equal to the matching subset's prevalence in the other three training scenes; no held-out labels enter it
calibration.caveat: The fitted map is pooled across room and object hypotheses. Object/room splits below diagnose that pooled map; they are not separately fitted per-kind calibrators.

definitions.completion_validity: accepted completions / expected four-member scene-track slots; missing members remain in the denominator
definitions.survivor_recall: sum of evaluator-matched true positives in predicted-only graphs after validation / sum before validation; the unchanged observed map is excluded and matching is recomputed after filtering so an equivalent surviving duplicate can replace a removed node
definitions.diversity: mean pairwise Jaccard distance between per-completion sets of case-folded (kind, label), macro-averaged over stage-tracks

false_positive_detour_gate.reason: Counterfactual policies selected stage-local poses but never navigated. The replay omits the live reachability gate and records no cumulative counterfactual path, so false-positive detour distance cannot be measured.
prohibited_substitutes: zero novel objects visible at a selected pose

combined_usefulness_claim.reason: The preregistered claim requires all conditions. Static quality and invalid-hypothesis checks cannot substitute for an unmeasured detour condition.

robot_collisions.reason: The pinned controller advances with agent.set_state and unconditionally increments path length; artifacts contain no contact, blocked-step, or collision sensor field. LLM check_collision text concerns proposed object boxes, not robot motion.
